motion.name: state-damping
motion.purpose: Blend shader uniforms and pointer rotations toward their current target each frame.

motion.name: particle-time
motion.purpose: Advance continuous deformation only when neither paused nor reduced motion is active.

motion.name: bounded-parallax
motion.purpose: Pointer coordinates are bounded approximately to -0.5…0.5; their rotational target is damped.

motion.name: simulation-cycle
motion.purpose: Cycle the six visibly labeled manual simulation states.

motion.name: research-progress
motion.purpose: Animate the two-pixel real research progress bar; removed for reduced motion.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Stop time-driven shader flow, CSS transitions/animations and smooth scrolling; explicit shader state changes remain observable.

motion.name: landing-action-transition
motion.purpose: Landing action state changes; removed when reduced motion is requested.

motion.name: research-inspector-entry
motion.purpose: Research inspector content changes only; disabled by prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.

motion.name: particle-render-scheduling
motion.purpose: Shared renderer: never outside the observed intersection (60px margin) or in a hidden document; demand while paused or reduced motion is active, with explicit state invalidation and uniform settling; always otherwise.

particleGeometry.note: Parametric WebGL geometry; no static shadow-DOM preview substitutes for the running canvas.

extensions.previewNotes: Tonal ramps are synthesized metadata in OKLCH, not new implementation tokens. Component snippets preserve source styles; native interactions and WebGL require the application runtime.

researchMetrics.argumentConclusionBasis: Local nomic-embed-text cosine similarity after successful final similarity analysis of at least two completed profiles with positions.
researchMetrics.fallback: Token-vector similarity while live or when embedding analysis fails or is unavailable.
researchMetrics.truncation: Each embedding input is capped at 5,000 characters; provider also requests tokenizer truncation.
researchMetrics.limitation: Embedding distance is not a judgment of philosophical merit. Stance categories and confidence remain provisional.

research.status: Incumbent documentation preserved; pre-existing drift not repaired.

laboratoryExtension.verification: Source inspection only; no new screenshot or runtime measurement claims.
laboratoryExtension.compatibleWith: Existing unprefixed surface/type/control tokens; original APORIA symbol and explicitly selected Obsidian & Iris shader palette are targeted approved additions.

dossier.structure: Flat ruled coverage register, evidence boundary, warnings, open questions, native provenance and compute disclosures

laboratoryExtension.recovery: In-flow role=status notice opens running/paused record; activeSessionId response loads existing record.
limits: Source checks do not establish runtime frame counts, contrast or visual clipping.
Mobile particle pause and quiet controls retain 36px minima; desktop icon controls remain 34px.
Existing generic component previews are preserved; the extension does not retroactively refresh their incumbent measurements.

landing.approval: User selected the original Divergent Apertures logo and Obsidian & Iris concept before implementation; this records the finished approved extension.
landing.depth: Live WebGL folded particle geometry with source SVG fallback; no shipping rasters.

narrative.overview:
A near-black field holds a folded, point-based volumetric topology. Cool blue, cyan and violet describe the object; warm regions signal conflict and pale regions signal insight. Manrope controls and Newsreader display copy keep the surrounding interface restrained.

The sculpture supplies spatial depth. Inspection uses flat sections, thin dividers and compact readouts rather than ornamental chrome. This is a code-authored WebGL medium; raster compositions are not part of the implemented design.

The user-selected original Divergent Apertures mark and Obsidian & Iris concept extend this system for the public landing route (`/`). The landing uses warm paper against obsidian, Source Serif 4 display typography and Source Sans 3 interface text. The folded particle object retains spatial depth; the surrounding surface stays flat and ruled. This is an approved route-specific addition, recorded from the finished implementation rather than a replacement of the research instrument.

The existing unprefixed frontmatter tokens and incumbent descriptions continue to govern the research application at (`/app`). All `landing-*` tokens govern only `src/landing/Landing.jsx` and `src/landing/landing.css`; the shared particle renderer selects the Obsidian & Iris palette when explicitly requested, including the approved laboratory particle adaptation documented below. The two APORIA font aliases are intentional additions to the system, not substitutions for Manrope or Newsreader.
keyCharacteristics: Folded particle geometry with cavities and asymmetry.
Near-black surfaces, cool information and warm conflict.
Quiet controls, fine dividers and compact numeric readouts.
State-driven deformation with reduced-motion and pause support.
Original Divergent Apertures SVG mark with a spaced APORIA wordmark.
Obsidian and warm-paper surfaces with iris, cyan and amber cognitive-state accents.
Source Serif 4 display and italic paired with readable Source Sans 3 controls and prose.
Flat fine-rule components, neutral policy identities and responsive illustrative paths.

rules.name: The State Color Rule
rules.body: Color carries cognitive or control state; preserve the existing cool, warm and pale state meanings.

rules.name: The Sculpture Depth Rule
rules.body: Keep interface chrome flat so the folded particle volume remains the source of spatial depth.

rules.name: The Landing State Color Rule
rules.body: On the landing, iris means reasoning, cyan means exploration and amber means conflict. Policy identities stay neutral; selected policy tabs use ink and an underline.

rules.name: The Paper Contrast Rule
rules.body: Switch to the darker paper-context accents and muted text whenever controls sit on warm paper; the pale obsidian-context accents are not text colors for the paper surface.

rules.name: The Route Typography Rule
rules.body: Use the APORIA aliases for the approved landing extension; retain Manrope Variable and Newsreader Variable for the research instrument.

dos: Do retain folds, cavities and asymmetry in the particle object at desktop and phone sizes.
Do use warm colors for conflict, objections, counterexamples and failure; use pale light for insight.
Do keep numeric readouts tabular and research inspection visually secondary.
Do preserve visible keyboard focus, reduced-motion behavior and explicit simulation labels.
Do keep landing-prefixed interface tokens and APORIA font aliases scoped to (`/`); the approved `/app` particle adaptation explicitly reuses the shader palette.
Do preserve the original Divergent Apertures SVG geometry and its spaced APORIA wordmark.
Do use darker accent and muted-text tokens on warm paper, and keep policy identities neutral.
Do retain explicit simulation and illustrative-workflow labels, visible focus, pause and reduced-motion behavior.
donts: Don't replace the particle topology with a generic sphere, robot avatar or chat interface.
Don't add neon HUD decoration, ornamental dashboard chrome or fixed overlays.
Don't present manually selected visual states as measured cognition.
Don't introduce raster art for the parametric particle object.
Don't replace research-app tokens or typography with the landing extension without a separate approved scope.
Don't turn cognitive-state colors into fixed profile-identity colors on the landing.
Don't replace the live folded geometry or its SVG fallback with a shipping raster illustration.
